notes: Launch options of the emulators, for the project's Emulator options dialog. VCSIDE passes only what the project sets; anything left on 'default' is whatever the emulator itself is set to.

Stella saves every command-line option into its settings when it quits (Settings::load/save in its sources), except a few local ones (-basedir, -break, -debug, -holdreset, -holdselect) and the ROM properties (-bs, -format, -tv, -ld, -rd, -lc, -rc, -sp, -cp, -startbank...). So VCSIDE runs it with its own copy of the user's settings: '-basedir <dir>' for the Unix and Windows builds, HOME=<dir> for the macOS app, which ignores -basedir.
Stella's dev.* options only apply with the developer settings on (-dev.settings 1); VCSIDE adds it when one is used ('developer': true).

Gopher2600 has no command-line flags for its preferences (sound, VSYNC checks, random state...). VCSIDE runs it in portable mode (portable.txt in the working folder, preferences in ./Gopher2600_UserData) with a copy of the user's preferences file and the chosen values.
Labels and descriptions are VCSIDE's own words; values and meanings were checked against the emulators' help, manual and sources.

es.description: Toca todas las ROMs en estéreo.

options.label: Developer settings
options.description: Uses Stella's developer set of settings (the dev.* options) instead of the player set. VCSIDE turns it on by itself when a developer option is set here.

es.description: Usa el juego de ajustes de desarrollador de Stella (las opciones dev.*) en vez del de jugador. VCSIDE lo activa solo cuando aquí se pone una opción de desarrollador.

options.label: Debug colours
options.description: Draws each object (players, missiles, ball, playfield, background) in its own fixed colour, to see what is being drawn where.

es.label: Colores de depuración
es.description: Pinta cada objeto (jugadores, misiles, bola, playfield, fondo) con un color fijo, para ver qué se dibuja y dónde.

options.label: Console info overlay
options.description: Shows scanlines, frame rate and the TV format on top of the image.

es.label: Información sobre la imagen
es.description: Muestra líneas, fotogramas por segundo y el formato de TV encima de la imagen.

options.label: Detected settings
options.description: Shows what Stella detected when the ROM loads.

es.label: Ajustes detectados
es.description: Muestra lo que Stella ha detectado al cargar la ROM.

options.label: Break on reads from write ports
options.description: Enters the debugger when the code reads a write address (for example the write port of Superchip RAM), which writes garbage on real hardware.

es.label: Parar al leer puertos de escritura
es.description: Entra en el depurador cuando el código lee una dirección de escritura (por ejemplo la de escritura de la RAM Superchip), que en el hardware real escribe basura.

options.label: Break on writes to read ports
options.description: Enters the debugger when the code writes to a read address, which does nothing but points to a bug.

es.label: Parar al escribir en puertos de lectura
es.description: Entra en el depurador cuando el código escribe en una dirección de lectura: no hace nada, pero delata un fallo.

options.label: Traps on ghost reads
options.description: Lets read traps fire on the 'ghost' reads the 6507 does on some addressing modes.

es.label: Trampas en lecturas fantasma
es.description: Deja que las trampas de lectura salten con las lecturas «fantasma» que hace el 6507 en algunos modos de direccionamiento.

options.label: PAL colour loss
options.description: Shows PAL frames with an odd number of lines in black and white, as a PAL TV does.

es.label: Pérdida de color PAL
es.description: Muestra en blanco y negro los fotogramas PAL con un número impar de líneas, como una TV PAL.

options.label: TV jitter
options.description: Makes the picture roll when the frame timing changes, as a TV would.

es.label: Temblor de la TV
